description: This file defines the MinimumVersionSelector class, which implements the IVersionSelector interface to select the minimum compatible version from a list of available versions based on compatibility checks.

classes.name: MinimumVersionSelector
classes.description: A class that selects the minimum compatible version from a list of available versions based on a compatibility check.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns the smallest available version that is compatible with the requested version, using the provided compatibility director.
